method: All triangle pairs whose AABB distance is below initial vertex-to-surface upper bound; minimum of vertex-face and edge-edge distances plus noncoplanar edge-face intersection tests. Distances in mm. No vertex-only gap claims.
limitations: No clinical contact tolerance or occlusion approval.
Only within-arch adjacency; no opposing-arch assessment.
Surface intersection is not a signed penetration-depth or volume-overlap estimate.
Source labels support FDI crosswalk, not independent anatomical laterality proof.
A positive mesh gap does not prove a biological gap; source segmentation and display resolution remain limiting.
Contained nonintersecting objects would not be identified as volumetric overlap by this surface test.
